diff.title: Ch 1 · Receiving goods — Inspection and booking
diff.before: Inbound operators [F-ROL-05] run procedure PR-01 [F-PRC-01]: the document check happens before unloading [F-ORD-01], and goods are inspected before they are booked into the system [F-ORD-02]. In the yard, trucks keep to 15 km/h [F-LIM-02]. Chilled deliveries are only accepted at or below +8 °C [F-LIM-09]. Dock approach lanes inside the hall keep the indoor limit of 10 km/h [F-LIM-01].
diff.after: Inbound operators [F-ROL-05] run procedure PR-01 [F-PRC-01]: the document check happens before unloading [F-ORD-01], and goods are inspected before they are booked into the system [F-ORD-02]. In the yard, trucks keep to 15 km/h [F-LIM-02]. Chilled deliveries are only accepted at or below +8 °C [F-LIM-09]. Dock approach lanes inside the hall keep the indoor limit of 8 km/h [F-LIM-01].

diff.title: Ch 6 · Internal transport and forklifts — Speed limits
diff.before: All internal transport follows PR-10 [F-PRC-10]. Forklifts must not exceed 10 km/h inside the building [F-LIM-01] and 15 km/h in the yard [F-LIM-02]; in marked pedestrian zones [F-LIM-03] and on dock ramps [F-LIM-04] the limit is 5 km/h. Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide [F-LIM-11].
diff.after: All internal transport follows PR-10 [F-PRC-10]. Forklifts must not exceed 8 km/h inside the building [F-LIM-01] and 15 km/h in the yard [F-LIM-02]; in marked pedestrian zones [F-LIM-03] and on dock ramps [F-LIM-04] the limit is 5 km/h. Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide [F-LIM-11].

diff.title: Ch 6 · Internal transport and forklifts — Operators and daily checks
diff.before: Forklift operators [F-ROL-03] are authorised by the warehouse manager only [F-RSP-08]; every truck gets a documented pre-use check each day [F-SCH-05], and the daily check happens before first use [F-ORD-08]. Seat belts are mandatory whenever the truck is moving [F-RUL-03]. The maintenance technician [F-ROL-08] logs all repairs. The check verifies the speed limiter setting for the 10 km/h indoor limit [F-LIM-01].

The check verifies the speed limiter setting for the 8 km/h indoor limit [F-LIM-01].

diff.title: Ch 9 · Emergencies and evacuation — Evacuation procedure
diff.before: Emergency evacuation follows PR-14 [F-PRC-14]. On the alarm, everyone leaves by the marked routes and gathers at the assembly point by the north fence. Roll call happens before anyone re-enters the building [F-ORD-09]. Outside drills, indoor traffic keeps to the 10 km/h limit [F-LIM-01].
diff.after: Emergency evacuation follows PR-14 [F-PRC-14]. On the alarm, everyone leaves by the marked routes and gathers at the assembly point by the north fence. Roll call happens before anyone re-enters the building [F-ORD-09]. Outside drills, indoor traffic keeps to the 8 km/h limit [F-LIM-01].

diff.title: Ch 13 · Pedestrian safety — Walkways and limits
diff.before: Pedestrian safety follows PR-11 [F-PRC-11]. Segregated pedestrian walkways are 1.2 m wide [F-LIM-13], separated from truck lanes by yellow barriers. Trucks slow to 5 km/h in marked pedestrian zones [F-LIM-03]; the general indoor limit is 10 km/h [F-LIM-01].
